Offers in excess of 695,000

Sherry FitzGerald Radford are delighted to present this exceptional coastal residence, occupying an enviable position 
along the South East coastline with breathtaking panoramic views stretching from Kilmore Quay to the Saltee Islands, the 
Keeragh Islands and Hook Head Lighthouse.

Beautifully transformed by the current owner, this remarkable home has been meticulously upgraded and extended to create a residence of outstanding quality, seamlessly blending timeless elegance with contemporary luxury and exceptional energy efficiency. Every detail has been carefully considered, from the exquisite finishes and bespoke joinery to the luxurious sanitary ware, creating interiors reminiscent of a five-star boutique hotel.

Extending to approximately 2,200 sq. ft. (204 sq. m.), the property offers beautifully proportioned accommodation that is both stylish and functional. Flooded with natural light, the interiors have been thoughtfully designed to maximise comfort while framing the spectacular coastal views from the principal living spaces.

The accommodation is arranged over two floors and begins with a welcoming entrance porch leading to a spacious reception hall. To the front of the property is an elegant formal drawing room, while a generous family room flows effortlessly into the impressive open-plan kitchen and dining area. This wonderful space forms the heart of the home, with large patio doors opening into a sunroom where uninterrupted sea views provide an ever-changing backdrop throughout the day. A well-appointed utility room and guest WC complete the ground floor.

Upstairs, there are four generously sized bedrooms, including a luxurious principal suite with en-suite bathroom, together with a beautifully finished family bathroom.

The exceptional standard continues outside. The landscaped gardens have been thoughtfully designed to complement the property's stunning coastal setting, offering a wonderful balance of manicured lawns, mature planting and private outdoor spaces in which to relax or entertain. Extensive cobblelock paving surrounds the home, while a spacious forecourt provides ample off-street parking. Mature hedging ensures complete privacy, and the desirable south-west facing aspect enjoys sunshine throughout the afternoon and into the evening.

A substantial detached garage is conveniently connected to the house via a covered car port, providing excellent storage, workshop potential or additional versatility to suit a variety of needs.

Perfectly positioned just a short stroll from the beautiful sands of Cullenstown Beach and only 3 km from Carrig-on-Bannow, the property enjoys the very best of coastal living. The village of Wellingtonbridge is approximately 10 minutes away, while Wexford Town can be reached in around 30 minutes, placing an exccellent range of amenities within easy reach.

Offering an unrivalled combination of spectacular coastal scenery, exceptional craftsmanship and luxurious contemporary living, this is a rare opportunity to acquire a truly distinguished home in one of County Wexford's most sought-after coastal locations.
